cases.name: Jennifer Kyli Molloy
cases.narrative: Documents said Beck admitted that he invited himself over to Kyli’s apartment the day of her death and that she allowed him to come inside. Beck tried to make romantic advances with Kyli but she refused, before asking him to leave. Beck admitted in the interview that he became violent and killed Kyli after she refused him, adding that he felt as if she “had wasted his time.”
